general_rules: No hypothesis is supported by direction alone; a predeclared precision/equivalence design must be frozen before fresh execution.
Parent P6 timings cannot be included in estimates, confidence intervals, thresholds, or stopping decisions.
No outcome-dependent arm removal, workload change, cooldown choice, warmup count change, or endpoint substitution.
If the decomposition cannot distinguish mechanisms, terminate as MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIED.
A valid negative is terminal evidence for the tested mechanism.

pass_requires: new harness modifications limited to instrumentation/conditioning controls
TTFT timer semantics explicitly mapped to decomposed endpoints
fresh seeds/order generated after design freeze
GPU timestamp query path available on exact Vulkan target
shared-footprint D0 can prepare both decode chains without changing prefill graph

F2_H1_EXECUTED_CARRYOVER.support_requires: Under shared prepared footprint, FAST_CONDITIONED and SAFE_CONDITIONED show a stable fresh difference in the preregistered TTFT component endpoint, with precision criterion defined before execution.
F2_H1_EXECUTED_CARRYOVER.reject_if: Difference falls inside preregistered equivalence region or direction is inconsistent under required repetitions/order blocks.

F3_H2_RESOURCE_FOOTPRINT.support_requires: FAST_ONLY_PREPARED and SAFE_ONLY_PREPARED differ under no-decode conditioning with preregistered precision.
F3_H2_RESOURCE_FOOTPRINT.reject_if: Difference is equivalent under the preregistered equivalence region.

F4_HOST_VS_GPU_LOCALIZATION.H3_host_support: CPU-observed regression is present while GPU timestamped prefill is equivalent; residual host/driver path accounts for the difference.
F4_HOST_VS_GPU_LOCALIZATION.H4_gpu_support: GPU timestamped prefill itself shows the preregistered regression under D0 shared-footprint conditioning.
F4_HOST_VS_GPU_LOCALIZATION.unresolved: Both move together without sufficient precision to localize -> MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIED.

F5_H5_ORDER_DVFS_ALTERNATIVE.support_requires: D0/D1 mechanism-specific contrasts are equivalent while neutral counterbalanced fresh processes reproduce order/state dependence.
F5_H5_ORDER_DVFS_ALTERNATIVE.reject_if: D0 within-process shared-footprint contrast supports executed-decode carryover independent of process order.

pass_requires: generated token hash remains exact for frozen workload
no change to Q4_FAST or prefill math

intervention_boundary.if_mechanism_supported: Open a separate bounded intervention specification inside this new program only if the intervention is uniquely tied to the supported mechanism and preserves Q4_FAST/decode semantics.
intervention_boundary.if_not_identified: No optimization or generic TTFT tuning is permitted.
